subject: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Katie Lang <katie@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask

Team —

We're at the quarter gate for the upcoming quarter and I need a short, actionable sign-off loop so we can lock the OKR slate by EOD Monday. Attached is OKR_draft_v3.xlsx (high-level objectives + proposed success metrics + owner slate). Key asks: 

- Please confirm your area-level objectives and owners (inline edits ok) by Monday 12:00 PT.
- Kimberly: confirm headcount request + gating rationale (I marked two T-shirt sizes).
- Laura: leadership endorsement or any veto items — call them out now so we can triage.
- Marissa: QBR packet owner + one-pager ask (we need the packet ready for exec readout).

Quick context: we tightened the measurement rubrics and removed two low-leverage experiments; this draft preserves runway for dedicated infra investments (cost/latency SLO work) but will need a resource gating decision for 3 FTEs on infra over the quarter.

Attachments: OKR_draft_v3.xlsx

Plan: consolidate changes Friday evening, send final for sign-off over the weekend, publish Monday morning. If any external blockers (procurement, legal), flag them here and loop the right stakeholders.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
VP, Platform & Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask

Sean —

Thanks for the draft. I made inline edits (see spreadsheet comments) and attached a short headcount rationale doc for the 3 infra FTEs. TL;DR on the headcount: two engineers to stabilize the new batching runtime and one product engineer to own performance regressions and rollout playbooks.

Open items I flagged:
- Can we postpone the model quantization experiment to Q+1 unless we get 2 of the 3 hires? Risk: quantization without the extra infra support will increase toil and likely regress latency SLOs.
- I added a proposed gating condition: hire approval OR a cross-team commitment of 4-week sprints from SRE to absorb initial ops burden.

Attachment: headcount_rationale.docx

On the QBR packet, I can commit to the infra slides if Marissa covers the customer-facing slate.

—Kimberly
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask

Thanks team —

Read the draft and Kimberly's rationale. High level: I endorse the objective slate with two conditions before I give formal sign-off:

1) Resource gating decision on the 3 FTEs or an explicitly scoped fallback (Kimberly's SRE 4-week commitment) documented and agreed by both infra and SRE leadership.
2) A short risk memo (one page) that calls out the quantization trade-offs and rollback criteria; route to legal if there are customer data handling concerns.

If we can get those two items by Monday noon PT, I will provide formal leadership sign-off. I added OPS-941 to track the gating conversation (see link).

Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask

Looping in customer context — Katie, we expect to include Acme Health in the QBR customer readout; please confirm if the proposed objective on reliability + latency aligns with your priority areas and whether you need anything in the customer slide.

Sean/Laura — I can own the QBR packet. I'll draft the exec one-pager and assemble customer one-pagers (including Acme). First pass will land Monday morning; final packet by Tuesday for exec reviews. I attached the initial QBR_packet_v1.pdf with the template and early customer bullets.

On procurement/legal: if we need expedited headcount approval with a contra-sign from Acme (for dedicated cloud spend), we should route a DocuSign envelope for the revised SOW. I can coordinate with Legal if Sean gives the greenlight.

Attachments: QBR_packet_v1.pdf

—Marissa
Senior Director, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter Gate: OKR confirmation, resource gating & QBR packet ask — Final sign-off

Thanks all — consolidated below and attaching the commitments doc and final packet. Where I didn't get explicit edits, I applied the draft owners from the sheet.

Final decisions / owners: 
- Objective A (Inference Reliability): Owner = Kimberly Park — hire request approved conditionally (Laura) pending DocuSign SOW or SRE fallback; Kimberly to confirm hiring timeline by Monday 12:00 PT.
- Objective B (Cost per token reduction): Owner = Dylan Brooks — reduce infra spend by 8% via batching and cache; deliverable = benchmark report by week 6.
- Objective C (Customer SLAs & QBR readiness): Owner = Marissa Cole — QBR packet owner, coordinate customer one-pagers (Acme) and confirm callout slides.

Open actions (prioritized):
1) Kimberly: commit to hire timeline or SRE fallback (due Mon 12:00 PT).
2) Marissa: finalize QBR_packet_v1.pdf and share final version for exec review (due Tue 09:00 PT).
3) Legal/Finance: prepare DocuSign SOW if hiring is approved and link to HubSpot deal.
4) Sean: publish OKRs after Laura's final sign-off (expected Mon 15:00 PT).

Attachments: commitments.md, QBR_packet_v1.pdf, OKR_draft_v3.xlsx

If any of the above items are blockers, call them out here. Otherwise I will close OPS-941 as "ready for exec" and publish the slate Monday afternoon.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Platform & Inference
Redwood Inference
